headlines.title_zh: GPT-6.2 Astra 解决了其他人工智能无法破解的数学定理，然后发明了自己的证明策略
headlines.title_en: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
headlines.author: Manuel Uth
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenAI的GPT-6.2 Astra模型在Autoform-Hard基准测试中，独立完成Smoktunowicz间隙定理的机器可验证证明
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra model successfully generated a machine-verifiable proof for the Smoktunowicz gap theorem on the Autoform-Hard benchmark, overcoming missing mathematical foundations in the library. By autonomously selecting a new research-based proof strategy, the model produced 1,800 lines of Lean code, signaling a transition from heuristic searching to creative proof generation in AI reasoning.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI (模型开发方)在Autoform-Hard基准测试环境：完成Smoktunowicz间隙定理的自主形式化证明
【起因与机理】验证大模型在缺乏现有库支持下的极端推理能力
【关键技术规格】模型自主生成Smoktunowicz间隙定理的Lean语言形式化证明。
【各方立场与态度】以49项任务完成率领跑Autoform-Hard基准测试排行榜。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI (Autoform-Hard benchmark): Self-generated formal proof of the Smoktunowicz gap theorem
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Benchmarking extreme autonomous mathematical reasoning
[Key Fact Detail] Autonomous generation of a formal proof in Lean language.
[Key Position & Outlook] Top performance on the Autoform-Hard benchmark with 49 solved tasks.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 模型表现出的自主策略重构能力，预示着AI在复杂逻辑演算与形式化验证领域将取代部分算法工程师的工作流，加速科研自动化进程。对于算力需求而言，这种无需人类干预的长链条推理将成为判断下一代通用人工智能（AGI）成熟度的核心技术指标。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The model's autonomous strategy reconstruction capabilities signal an acceleration in scientific automation, potentially offloading complex logic and formal verification workflows from human engineers to AI. This shift toward long-chain, unsupervised reasoning represents a critical benchmark for the maturity of next-generation AGI systems.

headlines.title_zh: Marlowe融资2.77亿美元挑战英伟达
headlines.title_en: Marlowe Raises $277 Million to Bolster Alternatives to Nvidia Chips
headlines.author: Bloomberg
headlines.event_summary_zh: AI计算基础设施公司Marlowe获2.77亿美元融资，计划利用AMD加速器构建数据中心以挑战英伟达市场地位
headlines.event_summary_en: AI infrastructure startup Marlowe has secured $277 million in funding to develop compute infrastructure utilizing AMD accelerators as an alternative to Nvidia hardware. The company plans to deploy its first data center by the end of 2026, aiming to challenge Nvidia's market dominance.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Marlowe在AI计算基础设施市场：完成2.77亿美元融资，布局基于AMD架构的数据中心
【起因与机理】通过多样化硬件选型削弱英伟达在AI算力供应链的垄断性
【关键数据与实测】获得2.77亿美元资金支持。
【各方立场与态度】核心商业模式为替代英伟达GPU提供基于AMD架构的算力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Marlowe (AI compute infrastructure market): Raised $277 million for AMD-based data center deployment
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strategy to reduce market reliance on Nvidia’s GPU supply chain
[Key Position & Outlook] Business model focused on providing AMD-based compute as a direct Nvidia alternative.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此轮融资反映了资本市场对AI算力成本优化与供应链去中心化的强烈诉求，AMD凭借ROCm生态的完善正在获得头部云厂商之外的中型基础设施运营商青睐。该举动将迫使英伟达在2026年后通过更激进的软件锁定或价格博弈来维持其在数据中心领域的话语权。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This funding reflects growing market demand for AI compute cost optimization and supply chain diversification, with AMD gaining traction among infrastructure operators via its improving ROCm ecosystem. This development will force Nvidia to maintain market share through more aggressive software lock-in or pricing strategies post-2026.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@RajeswarSai LLM 后期培训非常昂贵，正是因为 RL 的样本效率太低了。

在现实世界中，也就是我的蛋糕幻灯片的主题，强化学习只能发挥次要作用，正是因为它的样本效率低下。
celebrity.quote_en:
@RajeswarSai LLM post-training is so insanely expensive precisely because RL is so damn sample inefficient.

In the real world, which was the subject of my cake slide, RL can only play a minor role precisely because of its sample inefficiency.
